subject: Request: additional trial buffer due to integration drift
messages:
From: Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@opsly.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Gao <mark.gao@opsly.ai>
Date: 2027-09-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Integration drift impacting trial timeline — request for buffer

Hi Evelyn & Marissa,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough last week. We've started wiring Redwood into our ingestion pipeline and hit an unexpected set of compatibility issues in our event schema mapping that will push our demo-ready date out by about 3 weeks. Our engineering lead dug through logs and attached a short excerpt that shows the sequence mismatch (see attachment).

Concretely, this means we won't be able to produce the demo dataset you requested by the originally agreed date, and our pilot tokens are going to run low before we can complete the integration work. Can Redwood provide a short trial buffer (either additional sandbox credits or a 21-day extension on the trial window) so we can finish the adapter and still ship the demo for the exec meeting on Oct 22?

We've prepared a revised mutual action plan (MAP) and timeline — attaching v2. If you prefer, I can jump on a 20-min tech sync with Karthik to walk through the logs.

Attachments: integration-log-20270929.txt, mutual-action-plan_v2.xlsx

Appreciate the help,
Aisha Reynolds
Head of Integrations, Opsly
[aisha.reynolds@opsly.ai]

----
On Wed, Sep 30, 2027 at 08:58 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Looping you in — Opsly flagged the schema drift earlier this morning.
> 
> -Marissa
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@opsly.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration drift impacting trial timeline — request for buffer

Hi Aisha — thanks for the clear note and for the logs/MAP. Sorry to hear the schema mismatch is blocking your demo.

We want to avoid you hitting quota mid-integration. Provisional support: we can extend your sandbox access window by 21 days and provision a one-time token top-up while your engineers complete the adapter. I need to confirm exact credit amounts with Ben, and Karthik, can you give us a quick estimate of how many extra tokens or minutes you'd need to finish the integration end-to-end? If you can, please update the MAP with the target deliverables and a high-level engineer hour estimate.

If you prefer a short tech call, Karthik is available tomorrow morning (10–11am PT) — I'll hold that slot pending your confirmation.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: mutual-action-plan_v2.xlsx]

On Wed, Sep 30, 2027 at 09:12 AM Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@opsly.ai> wrote:
> Hi Evelyn & Marissa,
> ...
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@opsly.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-01T08:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration drift impacting trial timeline — request for buffer

Hi all — thanks for the detail, Aisha, and thanks Evelyn for coordinating.

Decision: we can approve a 21-day trial window extension + a sandbox credit top-up equivalent to 250k tokens as a one-time courtesy to Opsly while you finish the adapter work. This is contingent on the MAP being updated with milestone dates and a firm demo slot (so we can audit usage and ensure the uplift is scoped to the integration work).

Next steps for Opsly:
- Please upload the updated MAP with milestone dates and engineer-hour estimates (we need this by EOD PT on Oct 2).
- Confirm whether you want the extension to start immediately (Oct 1) or once we mark the MAP accepted.

I'll also prepare a short amendment to your trial terms (PDF) for sign-off to cover the additional credits. Marissa — can you place the provisional credit and attach the amended terms to the HubSpot deal when complete?

Ben Carter
Lead, Strategic Sales | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-trial-terms.pdf]
From: Aisha Reynolds <aisha.reynolds@opsly.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Opsly Legal <contracts@opsly.ai>
Date: 2027-10-02T14:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Integration drift impacting trial timeline — request for buffer

Ben / Evelyn — really appreciate the quick turnaround and the provisional uplift. We've uploaded the revised MAP (mutual-action-plan_v2.xlsx) to the Drive link you provided and marked the milestone dates. Per Karthik's ask, we've added a 120 engineer-hour estimate for the adapter finishing and testing.

We'd like the extension to start immediately so our engineering team can resume testing without swapping keys. For sign-off: Opsly Legal is copied — if you can send the amended trial terms as a DocuSign link, we'll countersign within 48 hours.

Attachments: acknowledgment screenshot (internal), MAP v2 uploaded to Drive

Thanks again — Aisha

----
On Fri, Oct 01, 2027 at 08:26 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi all — decision: 21-day extension + 250k tokens provisional uplift. Need MAP by EOD Oct 2.
> 
> -Ben
